headline: Bringing the Soul of West Bengal to Stockholm
intro: Queen's Kitchen was born from a passion for sharing authentic, home-style Bengali cuisine rooted in the rich culinary traditions of Kolkata and West Bengal, India.
story_body:
West Bengal's cuisine is celebrated for its delicate balance of aromatic spices, mustard oil, poppy seeds (posto), freshly roasted panch phoron, and signature sweets. Every dish at Queen's Kitchen is cooked from scratch in small batches — never mass-produced.

Whether you are hosting an intimate family gathering, a birthday celebration, a Puja feast, or a corporate lunch in Stockholm, we tailor every menu to your guests' preferences.

standards.title: Strictly No Beef & No Pork
standards.description: Our kitchen never cooks or handles beef or pork products.

standards.title: Authentic West Bengal Flavors
standards.description: Classic Kolkata Dum Biryani, Kosha Mangsho (mutton), Shorshe Maach, Cholar Dal & Mishti.

standards.title: Dietary Friendly
standards.description: Dedicated vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and halal-certified meat options available.
